module.purpose: Provides composite two-dimensional geometry that flattens nested groups and delegates geometric queries, intersections, hit testing, bounds, and path generation to child geometries.
module.summary: This module defines a composite geometry implementation for grouped shapes. It maintains active and ignored children, forces groups to be closed but unfilled, recursively flattens nested groups, and aggregates or delegates geometric operations across filtered children. Length-based interpolation traverses children in order, transformations rebuild the composite, and SVG output combines child paths with additional corner markers for simplified paths.
module.businessContext: Supports editor shape geometry and spatial interaction for grouped drawing elements. Failures can break selection, hit testing, bounds, intersections, rendering, and path-based editing for groups.
